source: 606 Faith Conversion
target: 606 Fides Conversionis

source: At 8 a.m., in the prayer room on the third floor of the cabin, Lugano stepped in.
target: Ad horam octavam ante meridiem, in cella precationis in tabulato tertio casae, Lugano intravit.

source: Father Montserrat, draped in a brown priest’s robe, was already preaching.
target: Pater Montserrat, indutus veste sacerdotalis fusca, iam praedicabat.

source: Five or six individuals were scattered in the rows of chairs before the Sacred Emblem of Life.
target: Quinque vel sex homines in ordinibus sellarum ante Sacrum Signum Vitae dispersi erant.

source: Without disturbing the sanctified ambiance, Lugano chose a spot at the front, near a supplicant.
target: Ne sanctum ambitum turbaret, Lugano locum in fronte, prope supplicem eligit.

source: As Father Montserrat concluded his sermon and closed the Holy Bible, the supplicants rose, spread their feet, and raised their palms high, chanting in unison, “Praise the Earth, praise the Mother of All Things!”
target: Cum Pater Montserrat sermonem confecerit et Sacram Bibliam clausisset, supplices surrexerunt, pedes extendentes et palmas alte tollentes, una voce canentes: “Laudate Terram, laudate Matrem Omnium Rerum!”

source: Lugano instinctively turned his head, noticing a tightly-wrapped up supplicant with brown eyes and a pale complexion in the same row—Enio, the special patient who had lost his internal organs.
target: Lugano instinctive vertit caput suum, animadvertens supplicem strictissime involutum, cum oculis fuscis et vultu pallido in eodem ordine—Enio, aegrotus specialis qui organa interna amisit.

source: H-he’s not dead?
target: Nonne ille mortuus est?

source: Wait, isn’t the evil warlock, Prinpino, supposed to be dead?
target: Heu, nonne maleficus magus, Prinpino, mortuus esse deberet?

source: Why is Enio, the special patient, still alive?
target: Cur Enio, aegrotus specialis, adhuc vivit?

source: Lugano was stunned, almost convinced he’d encountered a ghost.
target: Lugano stupefactus erat, paene persuasus se phantasma convenisse.

source: Being a Sequence 8 of the Planter pathway, he was ill-equipped to handle ghosts.
target: Cum esset Sequens VIII in via Planter, ad phantasmata tractanda non idoneus erat.

source: But then, Lugano observed that Enio’s face wasn’t as deathly pale as before.
target: Sed tum, Lugano animadvertit faciem Enii non tam pallide quam antea.

source: The brilliance in his eyes had returned, and vitality coursed through him.
target: Splendor in oculis eius redierat, et vitalitas per eum fluebat.

source: Wh… Lugano raised his hand, tapping his glabella to activate his Spirit Vision.
target: Quid… Lugano levavit manum, pulsans glabellam suam ad activandam Visionem Spiritus.

source: He observed Enio’s Ether Body, no longer as ashen as before.
target: Animadvertit corpus aethericum Enii, iam non tam pallide quam antea.

source: Whether it be the yellow hue symbolizing the digestive system, the orange hue denoting detoxification and organ excretion, or other shades, they had reverted to a semblance of normalcy, albeit faint and thin.
target: Sive sit color flavus, systema digestivum repraesentans, sive color aurantiacus, detoxificationem et excretionem organorum signans, sive alias umbras, illa ad speciem normalitatis redierant, quamvis pallidae et tenues.

source: Is that even possible?
target: Numquid hoc fieri potest?

source: Hadn’t he lost his heart, liver, spleen, lungs, intestines, stomach, and kidneys?
target: Nonne amiserat cor, iecor, lienem, pulmones, intestina, ventriculum, atque renes?

source: Lugano stared at Enio as though he were an aberration until Enio pivoted and pleasantly recognized him.
target: Lugano Enium quasi aberrationem contemplatus est, donec Enio se vertit et eum jucunde agnovit.

source: “Doctor, your treatment works wonders. I feel like I’m recovering!” Enio exclaimed joyously.
target: “Doctor, curatio tua miracula facit; me sanari sentio!” exclamavit Enio laete.

source: And this was just the initial treatment sans pinpointing the specific cause!
target: Et hoc solum erat initium curationis, sine causae specificae investigatione!

source: Lugano’s lips twitched stiffly.
target: Labia Lugani rigidis motibus contrahuntur.

source: “That’s reassuring, indeed.”
target: “Id certe consolatur, re vera.”

source: “Are you also a follower of Earth Mother?” Enio beamed, pleasantly surprised.
target: “Esne etiam sectator Matris Terrae?” subridens et iucunde obstupuit Enio.

source: I’m not.
target: Non sum.

source: Spare me the talk of Mother God or Mother…
target: Noli mihi sermonem de Matre Dei aut de Matre proferre…

source: As an Intisian, how can I subscribe to the Earth Mother faith?
target: Quomodo, ut Intisianus, fidem Matris Terrae suscipere possum?

source: Lugano gestured toward Montserrat, evading a direct response.
target: Lugano manu ad Montserrat indicavit, responsionem directam vitans.

source: “I need to discuss matters with the priest.”
target: “Necesse est mihi cum sacerdote de rebus disserere.”

source: Enio nodded.
target: Enio annuit.

source: “When can I seek further treatment in the morning?”
target: Quando mane ulterius curationem quaerere possum?

source: You don’t require treatment anymore.
target: Non amplius curatione indiges.

source: It’s time for recuperation and repose…
target: Tempus est ad convalescentiam et quietem…

source: Lugano grumbled, forcing a smile.
target: Lugano gemebat, simul risum fingens.

source: “In about an hour.”
target: Circa unam horam.

source: “Thank you, Doctor!” Enio waved, exiting the prayer room.
target: “Gratias tibi, Doctor!” exclamavit Enio, manu agitando cellam precationis relinquens.

source: When only Lugano and Father Montserrat remained, Lugano hushed his voice, gesturing toward the door.
target: Cum solum Lugano et Pater Montserrat remanserunt, Lugano vocem suam tacuit, ad ianuam indicans.

source: “H-how was he healed?”
target: “Q-quomodo curatus est?”

source: Father Montserrat, still relatively youthful with sincere eyes, smiled and responded, “Thanks to Earth Mother, his fortune was favorable.
target: Pater Montserrat, adhuc relative iuvenis et oculis sinceris, subridens respondit: “Gratias Matri Terrae, fortunam eius prosperam adeptus est.

source: “As a Doctor yourself, you must be aware that internal organs can be transplanted as long as they maintain a certain level of vitality.
target: ‘Quoniam doctor ipse es, scisne organa interna transplantari posse, dummodo certum gradum vitalitatis servant.

source: For the ritual to succeed, Prinpino utilized his Beyonder powers to sustain the vitality of those internal organs.
target: Ad ritui successum, Prinpino potentias suas Beyonder ad sustentandam vitalitatem horum organorum usus est.

source: Moreover, the set he employed was extracted from Enio, eliminating the need to consider transplant rejection effects.
target: Praeterea, series quam adhibuit ex Enio extracta est, eliminans necessitatem de effectibus repugnationis transplantationis considerandis.

source: “Furthermore, Enio remained alive, relying on mystical power to uphold a certain level of vitality.
target: “Praeterea, Enio vivus mansit, potentiam mysticam confugiens ad sustentandam certam mensuram vitalitatis.

source: This was a crucial factor.”
target: Hoc erat elementum praecipuum.

source: “Did you perform surgery on him last night and transplant all his internal organs back?” Lugano was enlightened.
target: “Num heri nocte operam chirurgicam ei perduxisti et omnia organa interna transplantavisti?” Lugano intellexit.

source: Father Montserrat nodded.
target: Pater Montserrat annuit.

source: “For regular surgeons, this is an operation with nearly zero chances of success.
target: “Pro chirurgis ordinariis, haec operatio spem successus paene nullam habet.

source: Even if successful, keeping the patient alive long enough to navigate the most perilous stage is challenging.
target: Etiam, si id efficitur, aegrotum vivo satis diu retinere ut periculosissimam partem transire possit, difficile est.

source: However, for us, it falls within our capabilities.”
target: Sed nobis, hoc in facultates nostras incurrit.

source: Indeed…
target: Certe…

source: Compared to ordinary surgeons, Beyonder Doctors like us wield mystical powers akin to miracle-workers…
target: Comparati ad chirurgos ordinarios, medici Beyonder, sicut miracula facientes, virtutes mysticas habent…

source: Lugano sighed, dismissing further concern about Enio.
target: Lugano suspiravit, de Enio ulterius sollicitiam relegans.

source: Turning to Montserrat, he inquired with worry, “Father, I heard a baby crying again.
target: Conversus ad Montserrat, anxie interrogavit: “Pater, iterum audivi infantem plorare.

source: “Has that so-called Child of God set his sights on me?”
target: “Num ille dictus Puer Dei in me conspectum tulit?”

source: Father Montserrat reassured him, “Fear not.
target: Pater Montserrat eum consolavit: “Noli timere.

source: It’s an inevitable repercussion of the corresponding corruption.
target: Ista est inevitabilis consequentia corruptionis correspondens.

source: It will gradually dissipate over time.
target: Paulatim per tempus evanescet.

source: If you’re concerned about any unforeseen events or accidents on your path, I can help you eliminate them now.”
target: Si de eventibus inopinatis aut casibus in via tua sollicitus es, nunc te adiuvare possum ut ea deleantur.

source: Is that so?
target: Num ita est?

source: You’re merely a Sequence 8 Doctor.
target: Tu solum es medicus Sequens VIII.

source: Do you possess the capability to rid me of the remaining corruption?
target: Habesne facultatem ut me a reliqua corruptione liberare possis?

source: Set up an altar and seek Earth Mother’s aid?
target: Altarum constitui et auxilium Matris Terrae quaere?

source: Lugano remained skeptical.
target: Lugano dubius remansit.

source: “Thank you, Father!”
target: “Gratias tibi, Pater!”

source: Montserrat gestured toward Lugano’s previous spot.
target: Montserrat ad locum priorem Lugani indicavit.

source: “Follow the believers’ example.
target: “Sequere exemplum fidelium.

source: Close your eyes, listen to my preaching, and simultaneously, pray to Earth Mother.
target: Oculos claude, praedicationem meam ausculta, et simul ad Matrem Terram ora.

source: Remember, it’s specifically to Earth Mother, no other deity!”
target: Memento, solum Matri Terrae, nullo alio deo, orandum esse.

source: “Understood.”
target: “Intellectum.”

source: Lugano resumed his seat, crossed his arms, and shut his eyes.
target: Lugano sedem suam reprisit, brachia transversa iunxit, et oculos clausit.

source: As Father Montserrat delivered his sermon, Lugano silently echoed the verses of the Holy Bible.
target: Dum Pater Montserrat sermonem suum proferre, Lugano versiculos Sacrae Bibliorum silentio repetebat.

source: Gradually, his thoughts blurred, and amidst the discourse, Lugano discerned a mother’s gentle murmur and felt the comforting warmth of her embrace.
target: Paulatim cogitationes eius evanuerunt, et inter sermonem, Lugano lenem murmur matrum perceptus est atque solaciorum calor in amplexu eius sensit.

source: His tense heart eased, reminiscent of seeking solace in his mother’s arms after childhood bullying.
target: Cor Lugani, quod tensum erat, lenitum est, reminiscens solacium quaesitum in amplexu matris post iniurias pueriles.

source: It was a blend of dependency, reliance, and a sanctuary for the mind.
target: Erat mixtio dependentiae, fiduciae, et refugii mentis.

source: Unbeknownst to him, tears trickled down Lugano’s cheeks, as if purifying his body and soul.
target: Mihi ignota, lacrimae per maxillas Lugani defuebant, quasi corpus et animam purgantes.

source: Slowly, his emotions settled, dispelling the fear and unease.
target: Paulatim affectus eius sedaverunt, timorem ac inquietudinem tollentes.

source: “Done.”
target: “Factum.”

source: Father Montserrat’s voice seemed to waft from the distance, reaching Lugano’s ears.
target: Vox Patris Montserrat ex longinquo fluitabat, ad aures Lugani perveniens.

source: Opening his eyes, Lugano raised his right hand, wiping away the tears.
target: Oculos aperiens, Lugano manum dexteram levavit, lacrimas abstergens.

source: Standing up, he lifted his hands.
target: Stans, manus suas levavit.

source: “Praise the Earth, praise the Mother of All Things!”
target: “Laudate Terram, laudate Matrem Omnium Rerum!”

source: It was an almost reflexive response.
target: Fere responsum quasi reflexum erat.

source: In that moment, sunlight streamed through the window, casting a faint golden glow upon the prayer room, as if heralding forthcoming abundance.
target: Illo momento, solis lumen per fenestram effluit, tenuem auream fulgurationem in cellam precationis iacens, quasi abundantiam venturam praeanuntiens.

source: Father Montserrat nodded in satisfaction.
target: Pater Montserrat, contentus, annuit.

source: “Earth Mother has purged the corruption from your body.
target: “Mater Terra corruptionem ex corpore tuo purgavit.

source: Tonight, pay attention and see if you still hear the baby’s cries!”
target: Hac nocte attende, et vide an adhuc clamores infantis audias.

source: “Alright, Father!” Lugano replied, his body and mind now at ease.
target: “Recte, Pater!” respondit Lugano, corpus et mens nunc in tranquillitate.

source: The next morning, he awoke with a sense of happiness.
target: Postero mane, cum laetitia replebatur, evigilavit.

source: Throughout the night, he experienced no dreams of a beckoning mother, nor did he hear the cries of the so-called Child of God.
target: Per noctem totam, nec somnia matris advocantis nec clamores dicti Puer Dei audivit.

source: Filled with joy, Lugano, after serving Ludwig breakfast, hurried to the prayer room to share the uplifting news with Father Montserrat.
target: Gaudio pleno, postquam Ludovico ientaculum obtulit, Lugano festinavit in cellam precationis, ut nuntium laetificum cum Patre Montserrat communicaret.

source: Father Montserrat gazed at him for a moment and asked with a smile, “Are you interested in embracing Mother Earth?”
target: Pater Montserrat eum per momentum aspexit et, subridens, rogavit: “Interesse tibi est Matrem Terram amplecti?”

source: “Me?”
target: “Ego?”

source: Lugano hesitated before inquiring, “Are you willing to accept the conversion of a heretic?”
target: Lugano haesitavit antequam rogavit: “Esne paratus conversionem haeretici accipere?”

source: Father Montserrat smiled and replied, “In the Mother’s eyes, there are no heretics.
target: Pater Montserrat subridens respondit: “In oculis Matris, haeretici non sunt.

source: There are only children who are or are not willing to return home.”
target: Sunt solum pueri qui domum redire velint aut non.

source: Lugano’s heart wavered, reflecting on his past actions of merely going through the motions in cathedrals—praying, listening to preaching, and attending Mass.
target: Cor Lugani vacillavit, reminiscens de actibus praeteritis, quibus tantum in ecclesiis cursu versatus erat—precando, praedicando audiendo, et Missam frequentando.

source: He hadn’t truly believed in any deity, and the Church hadn’t provided substantial assistance.
target: Numquam vere in ullam deitatem credidit, nec Ecclesia auxilium substantiale praebuit.

source: Moreover, if I truly become a believer in Earth Mother, I might gain access to subsequent potion formulas and Beyonder ingredients from the Church or the three Orders…
target: Praeterea, si vere fidem Matris Terrae accipiam, fortasse ad potionum formulas sequentium atque ingredientes Beyonder ex Ecclesia aut tribus Ordinibus perveniam…

source: Even if not, I’ll surely receive corresponding mysticism guidance…
target: Etiamsi non, certo recipiam instructionem mysticam correspondentem…

source: Lugano hesitated, finding various excuses to convince himself.
target: Lugano dubitavit, excusationes varias se ipsum persuadere quaerens.

source: Father Montserrat patiently waited, not pressuring him.
target: Pater Montserrat patienter exspectavit, eum non urgens.

source: He simply smiled, anticipating Lugano’s decision.
target: Simpliciter subridens, sententiam Lugani praevidens.

source: Eventually, Lugano raised his hands.
target: Postremo, Lugano manus suas levavit.

source: “Praise the Earth, praise the Mother of All Things!”
target: “Laudate Terram, laudate Matrem Omnium Rerum!”

source: He responded to Father Montserrat’s proselytization in this manner.
target: Ita respondit ad conversionem Patris Montserrat.

source: Father Montserrat’s smile broadened as he extended his arms.
target: Risus Patris Montserrat latius effusus est, dum brachia sua extendit.

source: “Welcome home.”
target: “Domum bene advenisti.”

source: Those words oddly warmed Lugano’s heart.
target: Illae verba mirabiliter cor Lugani calefecerunt.

source: It felt as though, after years of wandering and adventuring, he had finally returned home.
target: Videbatur quasi, post annos vagationis ac peragrationis, tandem domum redierit.

source: Fatigue lifted, and a sense of grounding enveloped him.
target: Lassitudo evanuit, et sensus stabilitatis eum cingebat.

source: “Praise Mother Earth.”
target: “Lauda Matrem Terram.”

source: Lugano crossed his arms over his chest.
target: Lugano brachia super pectum suum transversavit.

source: Father Montserrat nodded and commenced his true preaching.
target: Pater Montserrat annuit et veram praedicationem incepit.

source: “You believe in the source of life, the mother of all things, the propagation of the fertile land, the symbol of the crimson moon and reproduction, as well as the destination and the starting point of everything…”
target: “Credis in fontem vitae, in matrem omnium rerum, in propagationem terrae fecundae, in symbolum lunaris rubrae et reproductionis, atque in finem et initium cunctarum rerum…”

source: Lugano listened attentively, committing the information to memory.
target: Lugano attente auscultavit, notitias in memoria retinens.

source: Though not devout yet, this might become his future sanctuary.
target: Etsi nondum devotus, hoc futurum esse eius refugium poterat.

source: He recognized the importance of presenting his good side at all times.
target: Animadvertit momentum semper bonam imaginem suam ostendere.

source: Upon returning to the first-class suite, Lugano glanced nervously at Lumian, who was engrossed in studying the Southern Continent’s Dutanese, and stammered, “I-I’ve changed my faith to Earth Mother.”
target: Rediens ad conclave primae classis, Lugano anxie intuebatur Lumian, qui linguam Dutanensem Continenti Australis studebat, et balbutivit, “E-ego fidem meam ad Matrem Terram mutavi.”

source: As a fellow Intisian, would he despise and scorn me?
target: Ut socius Intisianus, num ille me detestaret et contemnret?

source: Lumian looked up and chuckled.
target: Lumian surrexit et subridens risit.

source: “Then make sure to radiate maternal brilliance.
target: “Tunc cura ut fulgor maternus effulgeat.

source: Ludwig is counting on you for some fresh fish.”
target: Ludwig in te confidit pro piscibus recentibus.

source: He doesn’t mind at all…
target: Minime id curat…

source: Lugano mumbled, not willing to let Ludwig go hungry.
target: Lugano murmure dixit, nolens Ludwig famem pati.

source: He embarked on a busy day.
target: Se intromisit in diem occupatissimum.

source: Late at night, after tending to Ludwig until bedtime, Lugano pondered briefly and decided to visit the prayer room.
target: Nox sero, postquam Ludwig usque ad tempus dormiendi curavit, Lugano parum meditatus est et decrevit cellam precationis visitare.

source: If the door was still ajar, he intended to offer a prayer before retiring for the night.
target: Si ianua adhuc paulo aperta esset, precationem offerre voluit antequam nocte se recuberet.

source: He had to make a good impression right from the beginning!
target: Exordio bonam impressionem creare debebat!

source: Lugano treaded the dimly lit stairs, approaching the prayer room with cautious steps on the creaking floor.
target: Lugano scalis vix lucentibus gradibus perrexit, cellam precationis cum passibus cautis super pavimentum stridulum accedens.

source: His footfalls grew hushed, wary of disturbing those engaged in prayer and potentially interrupting Father Montserrat’s embodiment of Mother Earth’s teachings through reproductive activities with a female believer.
target: Gradus eius silentiores fiebant, metuens eos in precatione versantes non turbari atque fortasse incarnationem doctrinae Matris Terrae a Patre Montserrat, per activitates reproductionis cum credula femina interrumpi.

source: Reaching the door quietly, Lugano extended his right hand, gently pushing it open.
target: Ianuam quiete attingens, Lugano manum dexteram protulit eam leniter aperiens.

source: The wooden door eased ajar, revealing a small gap without a sound.
target: Ianuam ligneam paululum aperuit, parvum rima sine sono revelans.

source: It’s not shut tight…
target: Non arcte clausum est…

source: Is he truly in the midst of reproduction? Lugano cautiously peered into the opening.
target: Num vere in reproductione versatur? Lugano in rimam cautissime intuebatur.

source: He observed the crimson moonlight enveloping the prayer room and Father Montserrat, draped in a brown priest’s robe, standing before the Sacred Emblem of Life.
target: Animadvertit lunam rubram, quae cellam precationis et Patrem Montserrat, indutum veste sacerdotalis fusca, ante Sacrum Signum Vitae involvit.

source: Folding his arms, Father Montserrat swayed gently, as if cradling a newborn child.
target: Brachia sua implicans, Pater Montserrat leniter oscillabat, quasi infans recens natum cunabulum portans.

source: However, there was nothing within his embrace.
target: Attamen, nihil in amplexu eius erat.
